## Jackalwere (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 CE Medium magical beast (shapechanger)  

**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10  

**Defense**

  **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 natural) as jackal or hybrid; 14, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural) as human  

**hp** 30 (3d8+6)  

**Fort** +5; **Ref** +6; **Will** +2  
**DR** 5/cold iron  

**Offense**

  **Speed** 40 ft. as jackal, 30 ft. as hybrid or human  

**Melee** bite +4 (1d6+1) as jackal, longsword +3 (1d8+1/19–20) and bite –1 (1d6) as hybrid, longsword +3 (1d8+1/19–20) as human  

**Special Attacks** sleep gaze  

**Statistics**

  **Str** 13, **Dex** 17, **Con** 15, **Int** 12, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 12  

**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 16 (20 vs. trip as jackal)  

**Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (bite)  

**Skills** Acrobatics +7 (+15 jump as jack, +11 jump as hybrid or human), Perception +10, Stealth +8, Survival +7 (+11 tracking by scent); **Racial Modifiers** +8 Acrobatics to jump as jackal, +4 Acrobatics to jump as hybrid or human, +4 Survival when tracking by scent  

**Languages** Common  

**SQ** alternate form  

**Gear** longsword  

**Special Abilities**

 **Alternate Form (Su)** A therianthrope’s natural form is that of the base animal. It can shift into two other forms as though using the polymorph spell on itself, though only a specific human form or hybrid form can be assumed. Equipment carried by the therianthrope in human or hybrid form shifts with it and is absorbed into its animal form. Magic items do not function while in this form. When a therianthrope shifts back into human or hybrid form, equipment (including magic items) returns to normal and function normally.
